top demo/tb_buf4.shbench for Ngspice
== analogLib/res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/res"
  vibox none
  vsym 1101032df2f5824a

pin PLUS inout 0 -30
  vplabel none
pin MINUS inout 0 30
  vplabel none

param r 1k
  unit Ohm
  doc Resistance
param m 1
  doc Multiplier

impl spice spice
  format spice "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} {r} m={m}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) resistor r={r} m={m}"

rect -6 -20 6 20
== demo/buf.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  vibox none
  vsym 11571711a55fd511
  vsch 496fd5c900f5bdf9
  vcdf 3b9a1185d1fdbb4b
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"termOrder\" (\"A\" \"Y\"))))"

pin A in -40 0
  vplabel none
pin Y out 40 0
  vplabel none

impl schematic schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

inst 9c1317 analogLib:res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R0
  r 2k

wire p797v3 0 -60 0 -30
wire xxpxay 0 30 0 60

port 4xnrrh 0 60 R0 Y
port 5a7szc 0 -60 R0 A
== demo/buf4.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  vibox none
  vsym 8c00b16877b7513c
  vsch c562c5c19e191a55
  vcdf 4e8ac34b11252ac0
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"termOrder\" (\"in<3:0>\" \"out<3:0>\"))))"

pin in[3:0] in -40 0
  vplabel none
pin out[3:0] out 40 0
  vplabel none

impl schematic schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

inst gs58w6 ./buf
  at 0 0 R0
  name I0[3:0]

wire 0zyyrf 40 0 80 0
  bus true
  vwidth 3
wire epnzab -80 0 -40 0
  bus true
  vwidth 3

label yjnhep -60 0 R0 in[3:0]
  voff 0 -3

port 3hza6w -80 0 R0 in[3:0]
port mg4dke 80 0 R180 out[3:0]
== demo/tb_buf4.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  vsch 4e1ad95a22950565

inst maz0aa ./buf4
  at 0 0 R0
  name I1
inst qx379m analogLib:res
  at 120 40 R0
  name R9
  r 10meg

wire 9kdcgt 120 -10 120 10
wire amsrtf 40 0 80 0
  bus true
  vwidth 3
wire v6mrk0 -80 0 -40 0
  bus true
  vwidth 3

label 05h9fz -60 0 R0 d[3:0]
label 8k8map 120 -10 R0 q[0]
label faj5kc 120 70 R0 0
  vinst I5
label fm55j9 60 0 R0 q[3:0]
